expectationProvenance: Ratified crypto.wipe contract; handwritten expected witness line, NOT captured native stdout

abi.arguments: the written native [U8] List header [len, cap, data]

cases: unique buffer: elements and spare capacity zeroed in place, header unchanged
shared buffer: fresh zeroed buffer of the same capacity, the shared one keeps its bytes, is marked zero-at-free, and its last release's free zeroes it
frozen capacity-0 bytes: fresh zeroes of the length, static bytes unchanged
